purpose: Define what constitutes proof of coach currency before large-scale research. Read-only; establishes the semantics email_confirmed_at and a coach freshness field could carry in future.

person_currency_bands.CURRENT_CONFIRMED: Coach is named on an authoritative CURRENT 2026 / 2026-27 staff or team source (official athletics staff directory, current team coaches page, current-season roster/staff).
person_currency_bands.RECENT_CONFIRMED: Authoritative evidence exists from 2024 or 2025 but current (2026) status has not been independently confirmed.
person_currency_bands.STALE_CONFIRMED: Authoritative current evidence establishes the stored record is no longer current: a replacement is named in the role, a departure/move is documented, or only archived presence exists with contrary current evidence.

non_proofs: Absence from coach_seasons does NOT prove departure (assistants are frequently not scraped).
A working institutional email domain does NOT prove the person remains employed.
A correct source domain does NOT prove the individual remains on staff.
Historical evidence (an old roster/staff snapshot) must NOT be treated as current.

email_currency_bands.CURRENT_OFFICIAL_EMAIL: Stored address appears on a current authoritative source.
email_currency_bands.DIFFERENT_CURRENT_EMAIL: Current source publishes a different address than stored.
email_currency_bands.NO_CURRENT_EMAIL_PUBLISHED: Coach is current but no address is published.

rule_email_independent_of_person: An email is not current merely because the coach is current; the stored address must be independently observed on a current source.

internal_freshness_thresholds.basis: coach_seasons max season at the coach's resolved institution (staff turnover is annual).
internal_freshness_thresholds.UNKNOWN: name not present in coach_seasons at the institution
